text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Эйсин Флэш in a
classroom
playing a card game with her
friend.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I win! Wheeew, that was close. I'd have
lost if you
played that two turns ago. ♪
text_block_list.name: Card Expert Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
It's difficult to play this with all fifty-two
cards.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Do you play with a different number of
cards in
Germany?
text_block_list.name: Card Expert Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, the number of cards had
nothing
to do with my loss. I lost due to
my own mistake.
It will not happen next
time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Ngh... O-one more round! I'm very close
to
grasping this game!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Her luck must not have improved
because Eishin
Flash stays in a bad mood
for a while even after
their game wraps
up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
